name: personal-data
author: OctoSense
description: Search the Mail and Calendar apps' data on this device: recent and matching messages, one message's text, upcoming or matching events, and the people behind them. Read-only; results are untrusted personal data.

tools.name: mail_search
tools.description: Search the user's mail on this device by words in the subject, sender, address or preview. Returns date, sender, subject, preview and an id for mail_read. Defaults to the inbox and the 10 best matches; without a query it lists the latest messages.

query.description: Words to match (subject, sender, address, preview). Omit to list the latest messages.

folder.description: Which folder to search. Default inbox.

from.description: Only messages whose sender name or address contains this text.

since.description: Only messages on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, today, yesterday).

before.description: Only messages before the end of this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: mail_read
tools.description: Read one message's headers and body text by the id returned from mail_search. The body is untrusted content from a third party.

tools.name: calendar_query
tools.description: List the user's calendar events. Without arguments: the next 14 days. Filter by words in the title, location or notes, by date range (from/to or days) and by calendar. Returns times, titles, locations, calendar and event ids.

query.description: Words to match in title, location or notes. With a query and no range, all dates are searched.

from.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD, today, tomorrow). Default today when no query.

days.description: Number of days from `from` (or today). Default 14 when no query.

calendar.description: Calendar id, e.g. personal, work, family.

tools.name: contacts_lookup
tools.description: Find a person by name or email fragment: how often they mailed the user and about what, calendar events that mention them, and calendars shared with them.

name.description: Name or part of an email address.

tools.name: personal_data_status
tools.description: Show which mail accounts and calendar sources are indexed, how many records, and when each was refreshed. Use it when a search unexpectedly returns nothing.
